title: Fe’lning noaniq shakllari
goal_uz: Dars oxirida infinitiv va gerundni to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz, maqsadni to, in order to va so that bilan ifodalaysiz va 10 ta turli fe’l qolipidan foydalanib gap tuza olasiz.

scenes.title: Infinitiv va -ing shakli
board: Lesson: Infinitives and Gerunds
(Fe’lning noaniq shakllari)
want to do · enjoy doing
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda boshqalarning gapini ko‘chirma gapda yetkazishni o‘rgandik. Bugun har bir gapda uchraydigan mavzu: ikki fe’l yonma-yon kelganda ikkinchisi qanday shaklda bo‘ladi? “I want to go” deymizmi yoki “I want going”? Dars oxirida eng keng tarqalgan fe’l qoliplarini bilasiz, maqsadni to‘g‘ri ifodalaysiz va tipik xatolardan qochasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we'll look at what happens when one verb follows another. Do we say I want to go or I want going? By the end, you'll know the most common verb patterns, express purpose correctly and avoid typical mistakes.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun bir fe’l boshqasidan keyin kelganda nima bo‘lishini ko‘ramiz. I want to go deymizmi yoki I want going? Dars oxirida eng keng tarqalgan qoliplarni bilasiz, maqsadni to‘g‘ri bildirasiz va xatolardan qochasiz.

scenes.title: Ikki asosiy shakl
board: to + verb = infinitive (to go)
verb + -ing = gerund (going)
Verb 1 → Verb 2: qaysi shakl?

examples.t: I want to learn English.
I enjoy learning English.

scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida ikkinchi fe’l ikki shaklda keladi. “To” bilan, masalan “to learn”, bu infinitiv. Yoki “-ing” bilan, masalan “learning”, bu gerund, ya’ni harakat nomi. O‘zbek tilida ikkalasi ham “-moq” yoki “-ish” bilan ifodalanadi: “o‘rganmoq”, “o‘rganish”. Shuning uchun tanlov o‘zbek tilidan ko‘rinmaydi. Birinchi fe’lning o‘ziga qarab tanlanadi, shu sababli qolipni yodlash kerak.
scenes.say: The second verb comes in two forms: to plus verb, the infinitive, and the verb with ing, the gerund. Which one you need depends on the first verb. I want to learn English. I enjoy learning English.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi fe’l ikki shaklda keladi: to va fe’l, ya’ni infinitiv, hamda -ing, ya’ni gerund. Qaysi biri kerakligi birinchi fe’lga bog‘liq. I want to learn English. I enjoy learning English.

scenes.title: Infinitiv bilan keladigan fe’llar
board: want · need · hope · plan · decide
promise · agree · refuse · offer · expect
learn · manage · afford · choose

examples.t: We decided to move to London.
He refused to help us.
examples.uz: U bizga yordam berishdan bosh tortdi.

examples.t: I can't afford to buy a car.
examples.uz: Men mashina sotib olishga qurbim yetmaydi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi guruh: infinitiv bilan keladigan fe’llar. Odatda ular kelajakka, niyatga, rejaga yo‘naltirilgan: “want, need, hope, plan, decide, promise, agree, refuse, offer, expect”. Yana “learn, manage, afford, choose”. Masalan, “manage to do” — uddalamoq, “afford to buy” — sotib olishga qurbi yetmoq. Mantiq shunday: “to” yo‘nalishni bildiradi, ya’ni hali amalga oshmagan ish sari qadam.
scenes.say: Many verbs take the infinitive: want, need, hope, plan, decide, promise, agree, refuse, offer, expect, learn, manage, afford. We decided to move to London. He refused to help us. I can't afford to buy a car.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p fe’llar infinitiv bilan keladi: want, need, hope, plan, decide, promise, agree, refuse, offer, expect, learn, manage, afford. Biz Londonga ko‘chishga qaror qildik. U yordam berishdan bosh tortdi. Mashina olishga qurbim yetmaydi.

scenes.title: Gerund bilan keladigan fe’llar
board: enjoy · finish · avoid · mind · miss
suggest · keep · practise · consider
imagine · give up · can't stand

examples.t: She enjoys cooking for friends.
examples.uz: U do‘stlari uchun ovqat pishirishni yoqtiradi.

examples.t: Do you mind opening the window?
I've given up smoking.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi guruh: “-ing” bilan keladigan fe’llar: “enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, miss, suggest, keep, practise, consider, imagine, give up”. Ular odatda amalning o‘zini, ko‘pincha allaqachon bo‘lgan yoki umuman faoliyatni bildiradi. “Do you mind opening the window?” — muloyim iltimos, “derazani ochsangiz bo‘ladimi?”. Ingliz tilida “practise” fe’l, Amerikada esa “practice” deb yoziladi.
scenes.say: Other verbs take the gerund: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, miss, suggest, keep, practise, consider, imagine, give up. She enjoys cooking for friends. Do you mind opening the window? I've given up smoking.
scenes.say_uz: Boshqa fe’llar gerund bilan keladi: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, miss, suggest, keep, practise, consider, imagine, give up. U ovqat pishirishni yoqtiradi. Derazani ochsangiz bo‘ladimi? Men chekishni tashladim.

scenes.title: Fe’lni noto‘g‘ri qolipga qo‘yish
board: ✗ I enjoy to read. → ✓ I enjoy reading.
✗ She wants going home. → ✓ She wants to go home.
✗ He suggested to go. → ✓ He suggested going.
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p xatolar shu yerda. “Enjoy” dan keyin “to” qo‘yib bo‘lmaydi: “I enjoy to read” noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “I enjoy reading”. “Want” dan keyin esa “-ing” kelmaydi: “wants to go”. “Suggest” ayniqsa ayyor: o‘zbekcha “borishni taklif qildi” deymiz, shuning uchun “suggested to go” deyishga moyil bo‘lamiz. To‘g‘risi “suggested going”. Har bir yangi fe’lni qolibi bilan birga yodlang.
scenes.say: Don't mix the patterns. I enjoy to read is wrong, say I enjoy reading. She wants going home is wrong, say she wants to go home. And he suggested to go should be he suggested going.
scenes.say_uz: Qoliplarni aralashtirmang. I enjoy to read noto‘g‘ri, I enjoy reading deng. She wants going home noto‘g‘ri, she wants to go home deng. He suggested to go emas, he suggested going.

scenes.title: To yoki -ing?
board: 1) I decided ___ (take) a taxi.
2) She avoids ___ (eat) sugar.
3) They hope ___ (win) the match.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklga qo‘ying. Birinchi: “I decided, take, a taxi”. Ikkinchi: “She avoids, eat, sugar”. Uchinchi: “They hope, win, the match”. Birinchi fe’lga qarang: u infinitiv guruhidami yoki gerund guruhidami? Baland ovozda to‘liq gapni ayting.
scenes.say: Complete with the correct form. One: I decided, take, a taxi. Two: She avoids, eat, sugar. Three: They hope, win, the match.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri shaklni qo‘ying. Bir: I decided, take, a taxi. Ikki: She avoids, eat, sugar. Uch: They hope, win, the match.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I decided to take a taxi.
2) She avoids eating sugar.
3) They hope to win the match.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I decided to take a taxi”, chunki “decide” infinitiv bilan keladi. Ikkinchi: “She avoids eating sugar”, “avoid” gerund guruhida. Uchinchi: “They hope to win the match”, “hope” infinitiv bilan. Agar xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, o‘zingizni koyimang: aynan shu ro‘yxatni takrorlash bilan qoliplar xotirada o‘rnashadi.
scenes.say: One: I decided to take a taxi. Two: She avoids eating sugar. Three: They hope to win the match.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: I decided to take a taxi. Ikki: She avoids eating sugar. Uch: They hope to win the match.

scenes.title: Ikkala shakl bilan, ma’no o‘zgarmaydi
board: like · love · hate · prefer
start · begin · continue
I like swimming. = I like to swim.

examples.t: It started raining. / It started to rain.
I prefer walking. / I prefer to walk.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi xabar: ba’zi fe’llar ikkala shaklni qabul qiladi va ma’no deyarli o‘zgarmaydi. Bular “like, love, hate, prefer” va “start, begin, continue”. “It started raining” va “It started to rain” bir xil. Bir nozik tafovut bor: “like swimming” umuman yoqtirishni, “like to swim” esa odat yoki tanlovni bildirishi mumkin. Lekin amalda farqni sezmasangiz ham bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Some verbs take either form with almost no change in meaning: like, love, hate, prefer, start, begin and continue. It started raining. It started to rain. I prefer walking. I prefer to walk.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zi fe’llar ikkala shaklni oladi va ma’no deyarli o‘zgarmaydi: like, love, hate, prefer, start, begin, continue. It started raining. It started to rain. I prefer walking. I prefer to walk.

scenes.title: Remember va forget
board: remember to do = esda tutib qilmoq
remember doing = qilganini eslamoq
forget to do ≠ forget doing

examples.t: Remember to lock the door.
I remember locking the door.

scenes.say_native: Endi ma’no o‘zgaradigan fe’llar. “Remember to do” — qilishni esda tutmoq, hali qilinmagan ish: “Remember to lock the door”. “Remember doing” — o‘tmishda qilganingizni eslamoq: “I remember locking the door”, ya’ni qulflaganim esimda. “Forget” ham shunday: “I forgot to call” — qo‘ng‘iroq qilishni unutdim, “I’ll never forget meeting her” — u bilan uchrashganimni hech qachon unutmayman.
scenes.say: Some verbs change meaning. Remember to do means you don't forget to do something. Remember doing means you recall something from the past. Remember to lock the door. I remember locking the door.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zi fe’llar ma’no o‘zgartiradi. Remember to do — qilishni unutmaslik. Remember doing — o‘tmishdagi ishni eslash. Remember to lock the door. I remember locking the door.

scenes.title: Stop va try
board: stop to do = to‘xtab, boshqa ish qilmoq
stop doing = ishni to‘xtatmoq
try to do = urinmoq · try doing = sinab ko‘rmoq

examples.t: He stopped to buy water.
examples.uz: U suv sotib olish uchun to‘xtadi.

examples.t: He stopped smoking.
Try restarting the computer.

scenes.say_native: “Stop” bilan ehtiyot bo‘ling. “He stopped to buy water” — u suv olish uchun to‘xtadi, ya’ni to‘xtashning maqsadi shu. “He stopped smoking” — u chekishni tashladi. “Try” ham ikki xil: “try to do” — qiyin ishni uddalashga urinmoq, “try doing” — natijani ko‘rish uchun sinab ko‘rmoq. “Try restarting the computer” — kompyuterni qayta yoqib ko‘ring, balki ishlab ketar.
scenes.say: Stop to do means stop in order to do something else. Stop doing means end an action. Try to do means make an effort. Try doing means experiment to see the result. He stopped to buy water. Try restarting the computer.
scenes.say_uz: Stop to do — boshqa ish uchun to‘xtash. Stop doing — ishni tugatish. Try to do — urinish. Try doing — natijani ko‘rish uchun sinash. He stopped to buy water. Try restarting the computer.

scenes.title: Ma’noni chalkashtirish
board: ✗ I stopped to smoke. (= to‘xtab chekdim)
✓ I stopped smoking. (= tashladim)
✗ I forgot meeting... → ✓ I forgot to meet...
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda ma’no butunlay o‘zgarib ketadi. Agar “chekishni tashladim” demoqchi bo‘lsangiz va “I stopped to smoke” desangiz, inglizlar “chekish uchun to‘xtadim” deb tushunadi. To‘g‘risi “I stopped smoking”. Xuddi shunday, “uchrashishni unutdim” degani “I forgot to meet”, “I forgot meeting” esa “uchrashganimni unutdim” bo‘ladi. Xatoning narxi: boshqa ma’no.
scenes.say: Be careful, the meaning changes completely. I stopped to smoke means I paused in order to smoke. If you gave up, say I stopped smoking. I forgot to meet him means I didn't meet him.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtiyot bo‘ling, ma’no butunlay o‘zgaradi. I stopped to smoke — chekish uchun to‘xtadim. Tashlagan bo‘lsangiz, I stopped smoking deng. I forgot to meet him — u bilan uchrashishni unutdim.

scenes.title: Ma’noni tanlang
board: 1) Remember ___ the tickets! (buy)
2) I remember ___ this film as a child. (see)
3) She stopped ___ a coffee. (have)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Birinchi: “Remember, buy, the tickets” — hali olinmagan chiptalar. Ikkinchi: “I remember, see, this film as a child” — bolaligimda ko‘rganim esimda. Uchinchi: “She stopped, have, a coffee” — u qahva ichish uchun to‘xtadi. Har bir gapning ma’nosiga qarab infinitiv yoki gerund tanlang.
scenes.say: Think about the meaning. One: Remember, buy, the tickets. Two: I remember, see, this film as a child. Three: She stopped, have, a coffee, for a break.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’noga qarang. Bir: Remember, buy, the tickets. Ikki: I remember, see, this film as a child. Uch: She stopped, have, a coffee, tanaffus uchun.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Remember to buy the tickets!
2) I remember seeing this film as a child.
3) She stopped to have a coffee.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Remember to buy”, chunki bu kelajakdagi vazifa. Ikkinchi: “I remember seeing”, chunki bu o‘tmishdagi xotira. Uchinchi: “She stopped to have a coffee”, chunki to‘xtashdan maqsad qahva ichish. Qoida oddiy: hali bo‘lmagan ish va maqsad uchun infinitiv, o‘tmishdagi yoki davom etgan ish uchun gerund.
scenes.say: One: Remember to buy the tickets. Two: I remember seeing this film as a child. Three: She stopped to have a coffee.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Remember to buy the tickets. Ikki: I remember seeing this film as a child. Uch: She stopped to have a coffee.

scenes.title: Maqsad: to va in order to
board: I went to the bank to get money.
in order to + verb (rasmiyroq)
so as not to + verb (inkor)

examples.t: I'm learning English to get a better job.
examples.uz: Yaxshiroq ish olish uchun ingliz tilini o‘rganyapman.

examples.t: She left early in order to catch the train.
examples.uz: U poyezdga ulgurish uchun erta ketdi.

examples.t: Speak quietly so as not to wake the baby.

scenes.say_native: Endi maqsad. “Nima uchun?” degan savolga infinitiv bilan javob beramiz: “I went to the bank to get money”. O‘zbek tilida “pul olish uchun” deymiz, ingliz tilida “for” kerak emas. Rasmiyroq uslubda “in order to”. Inkor maqsadda “so as not to” yoki “in order not to”: “Speak quietly so as not to wake the baby”. Oddiy “not to” ham mumkin, lekin “so as not to” ancha aniq.
scenes.say: To express purpose, use the infinitive. I went to the bank to get money. For a more formal style, use in order to. For a negative purpose, use so as not to: speak quietly so as not to wake the baby.
scenes.say_uz: Maqsadni infinitiv bilan ifodalaymiz. I went to the bank to get money. Rasmiyroq uslubda in order to. Inkor maqsadda so as not to: speak quietly so as not to wake the baby.

scenes.title: For to emas
board: ✗ I came here for to study.
✗ I use a phone for call.
✓ I came here to study. / I use a phone for calling.
scenes.say_native: Maqsadda eng ko‘p xato: “for” ni infinitiv oldidan qo‘yish. “I came here for to study” noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “to study”. “For” dan keyin esa ot yoki “-ing” keladi: “I use a phone for calling”, “I came here for the course”. Fe’lning o‘zi “for” dan keyin boshlang‘ich shaklda kelmaydi.
scenes.say: A common mistake is putting for before the infinitive. I came here for to study is wrong. Say I came here to study. After for, use a noun or an ing form: I use a phone for calling.
scenes.say_uz: Keng tarqalgan xato — infinitiv oldidan for qo‘yish. I came here for to study noto‘g‘ri. I came here to study deng. For dan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi: I use a phone for calling.

scenes.title: So that
board: so that + subject + can / could
I'm saving money so that I can travel.
to + verb: ega bir xil bo‘lsa

examples.t: He wrote it down so that he wouldn't forget.
I'll send a map so that you can find us.

scenes.say_native: Agar maqsaddagi ega boshqa bo‘lsa yoki gapda “can, could, would” kerak bo‘lsa, “so that” ishlatamiz. “I’ll send a map so that you can find us” — xaritani men yuboraman, topadigan esa siz. Ega bir xil bo‘lganda “to” sodda va yaxshi: “I’m saving money to travel”. “So that” dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi: ega va fe’l. O‘tgan zamonda “so that he could” yoki “wouldn’t” deymiz.
scenes.say: Use so that when the second part has its own subject, or needs can, could or would. I'll send a map so that you can find us. If the subject is the same, to is simpler: I'm saving money to travel.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi qismda o‘z egasi yoki can, could, would kerak bo‘lsa so that ishlating. I'll send a map so that you can find us. Ega bir xil bo‘lsa to sodda: I'm saving money to travel.

scenes.title: Maqsadni ayting
board: 1) Why do you study English?
2) Why do people use umbrellas?
3) Why did he whisper?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta savolga maqsadni bildirib javob bering. Birinchi: nima uchun ingliz tilini o‘rganasiz? Ikkinchi: odamlar nima uchun soyabon ishlatadi? Uchinchi: u nima uchun pichirlab gapirdi, masalan chaqaloq uxlab yotgan edi. Har bir javobni “to” yoki “so as not to” bilan boshlang.
scenes.say: Answer with purpose. One: Why do you study English? Two: Why do people use umbrellas? Three: Why did he whisper? The baby was sleeping.
scenes.say_uz: Maqsad bilan javob bering. Bir: Nega ingliz tilini o‘rganasiz? Ikki: Odamlar nega soyabon ishlatadi? Uch: U nega pichirladi? Chaqaloq uxlab yotgan edi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) To get a better job. / To travel.
2) To stay dry.
3) So as not to wake the baby.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi savolga, masalan, “To get a better job” yoki “To work abroad”. Ikkinchi: “To stay dry”, ya’ni quruq qolish uchun. Uchinchi: “So as not to wake the baby”, chaqaloqni uyg‘otmaslik uchun. Sizning birinchi javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin va bu to‘g‘ri, asosiysi “to” dan keyin fe’l boshlang‘ich shaklda bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: One: To get a better job, or To travel. Two: To stay dry. Three: So as not to wake the baby.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: To get a better job yoki To travel. Ikki: To stay dry. Uch: So as not to wake the baby.

scenes.title: Predlogdan keyin -ing
board: interested in learning
good at cooking · afraid of flying
look forward to meeting · thank you for helping

examples.t: I'm interested in learning Spanish.
I look forward to seeing you.
Thanks for helping me.

scenes.say_native: Muhim qoida: predlogdan keyin fe’l doim “-ing” shaklida bo‘ladi, infinitiv emas. “Interested in learning”, “good at cooking”, “afraid of flying”, “thank you for helping”. Alohida diqqat: “look forward to” dagi “to” predlog, shuning uchun “I look forward to seeing you”, “to see” emas. O‘zbek tilida “o‘rganishga qiziqaman” deymiz, ingliz tilida “in” plus “-ing”.
scenes.say: After a preposition, always use the ing form. Interested in learning, good at cooking, afraid of flying, thank you for helping. Look forward to is special because to is a preposition: I look forward to seeing you.
scenes.say_uz: Predlogdan keyin doim -ing shakli keladi. Interested in learning, good at cooking, afraid of flying, thank you for helping. Look forward to maxsus: bu yerda to predlog: I look forward to seeing you.

scenes.title: Predlogdan keyin infinitiv
board: ✗ I'm interested to learn Spanish. (so‘zlashuvda uchraydi)
✓ I'm interested in learning Spanish.
✗ I look forward to see you. → ✓ seeing
scenes.say_native: Xato: predlogdan keyin infinitiv qo‘yish. Ayniqsa “I look forward to see you” juda keng tarqalgan. To‘g‘risi “to seeing”. Yodlash usuli: “look forward to” dan keyin “the party” kabi ot qo‘ya olsangiz, demak “to” predlog, fe’l esa “-ing” bo‘ladi. “Look forward to the party” to‘g‘ri, shuning uchun “look forward to seeing” ham to‘g‘ri. Xuddi shunday “be used to doing” — qilishga o‘rganib qolgan bo‘lmoq.
scenes.say: Don't use the infinitive after a preposition. I look forward to see you is wrong. Say I look forward to seeing you. Test: if you can say look forward to the party, then to is a preposition and needs ing.
scenes.say_uz: Predlogdan keyin infinitiv qo‘ymang. I look forward to see you noto‘g‘ri. I look forward to seeing you deng. Tekshiruv: look forward to the party desa bo‘lsa, to predlog, demak -ing kerak.

scenes.title: Predlog va fe’l
board: 1) She's afraid of ___ (drive).
2) Thank you for ___ (invite) me.
3) I'm looking forward to ___ (meet) your family.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklga qo‘ying. Birinchi: “She’s afraid of, drive”. Ikkinchi: “Thank you for, invite, me”. Uchinchi: “I’m looking forward to, meet, your family”. Predlog bor, demak qanday shakl kerak? To‘liq gapni ayting. Uchinchi gapda “to” ni predlog deb eslang va xotirjam o‘ylang.
scenes.say: Complete the sentences. One: She's afraid of, drive. Two: Thank you for, invite, me. Three: I'm looking forward to, meet, your family.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni to‘ldiring. Bir: She's afraid of, drive. Ikki: Thank you for, invite, me. Uch: I'm looking forward to, meet, your family.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) She's afraid of driving.
2) Thank you for inviting me.
3) I'm looking forward to meeting your family.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “afraid of driving”. Ikkinchi: “thank you for inviting me”. Uchinchi: “looking forward to meeting your family”. Uchalasida ham predlog bor va shuning uchun fe’l “-ing” shaklida. Uchinchi gap ayniqsa ko‘pchilikni chalg‘itadi, shuning uchun “to” ni predlog deb eslang.
scenes.say: One: She's afraid of driving. Two: Thank you for inviting me. Three: I'm looking forward to meeting your family.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: She's afraid of driving. Ikki: Thank you for inviting me. Uch: I'm looking forward to meeting your family.

scenes.title: Fe’l + kim + infinitiv
board: want / ask / tell / allow + kim + to do
would like + kim + to do
let / make + kim + do (to siz)

examples.t: My boss wants me to work late.
They allowed us to park here.
examples.uz: Ular bizga bu yerda to‘xtashga ruxsat berdi.

examples.t: She made me laugh.

scenes.say_native: Keyingi qolip: fe’l, keyin kim, keyin infinitiv. “Want, ask, tell, allow, would like, advise, expect” shu qolipda keladi: “My boss wants me to work late”. O‘zbekcha “mening ishlashimni xohlaydi” deymiz, ingliz tilida “that” gapi emas. Ikkita istisno: “make” va “let” dan keyin “to” tushadi: “She made me laugh”, “He let me go”. Va “want that” deb bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: Some verbs take an object and then the infinitive: want, ask, tell, allow, advise, expect and would like. My boss wants me to work late. But after make and let, we drop to: she made me laugh, he let me go.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zi fe’llardan keyin kim va infinitiv keladi: want, ask, tell, allow, advise, expect, would like. My boss wants me to work late. Make va let dan keyin to tushadi: she made me laugh, he let me go.

scenes.title: Want that
board: ✗ I want that you help me.
✓ I want you to help me.
✗ She made me to cry. → ✓ made me cry
scenes.say_native: Bu xato rus va o‘zbek tilidan keladi: “Я хочу, чтобы ты помог” — “Men sen yordam berishingni xohlayman”. Inglizcha “I want that you help me” noto‘g‘ri. To‘g‘risi “I want you to help me”. “Make” dan keyin ham “to” qo‘shmang: “She made me to cry” emas, “She made me cry”. “Let” ham xuddi shunday. Lekin passivda “I was made to wait” deymiz, bu keyingi bosqichlar mavzusi.
scenes.say: Don't translate with that. I want that you help me is wrong. Say I want you to help me. And after make, don't add to: she made me cry, not she made me to cry.
scenes.say_uz: That bilan tarjima qilmang. I want that you help me noto‘g‘ri. I want you to help me deng. Make dan keyin to qo‘shmang: she made me cry.

scenes.title: Qolipni tuzing
board: 1) My mother wants / I / call her
2) The teacher told / us / open our books
3) Dad let / me / drive his car
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Berilgan so‘zlardan to‘g‘ri gap tuzing. Birinchi: “My mother wants, I, call her”. Ikkinchi: “The teacher told, us, open our books”. Uchinchi: “Dad let, me, drive his car”. “I” ni “me” ga o‘zgartirishni unutmang. Uchinchisida “to” kerakmi? O‘ylab ko‘ring, keyin to‘liq gapni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Make correct sentences. One: My mother wants, I, call her. Two: The teacher told, us, open our books. Three: Dad let, me, drive his car.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri gap tuzing. Bir: My mother wants, I, call her. Ikki: The teacher told, us, open our books. Uch: Dad let, me, drive his car.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) My mother wants me to call her.
2) The teacher told us to open our books.
3) Dad let me drive his car.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “My mother wants me to call her”, “I” emas, “me”. Ikkinchi: “The teacher told us to open our books”. Uchinchi: “Dad let me drive his car”, bu yerda “to” yo‘q. Oxirgisini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, istisnani o‘zlashtirgansiz. Birinchi gapda “I” o‘rniga “me” kelganini ham unutmang.
scenes.say: One: My mother wants me to call her. Two: The teacher told us to open our books. Three: Dad let me drive his car, with no to.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: My mother wants me to call her. Ikki: The teacher told us to open our books. Uch: Dad let me drive his car, to siz.

scenes.title: Sifat + infinitiv, too va enough
board: easy / hard / happy / glad + to do
too + adj + to do
adj + enough + to do

examples.t: It's easy to forget your keys.
I'm too tired to cook.
He isn't old enough to drive.
examples.uz: U mashina haydash uchun yetarlicha katta emas.

scenes.say_native: Sifatdan keyin ham infinitiv keladi: “easy to forget”, “happy to help”, “glad to see you”. Yana ikki foydali qolip. “Too plus sifat plus to” — haddan tashqari, shuning uchun mumkin emas: “I’m too tired to cook”. “Sifat plus enough plus to” — yetarli: “He isn’t old enough to drive”. Diqqat: “enough” sifatdan keyin keladi, oldin emas: “old enough”, “enough old” emas.
scenes.say: Adjectives can be followed by the infinitive: easy to forget, happy to help. Too plus adjective plus to means it's more than needed. I'm too tired to cook. Enough comes after the adjective: he isn't old enough to drive.
scenes.say_uz: Sifatdan keyin infinitiv keladi: easy to forget, happy to help. Too plus sifat plus to — ortiqcha. I'm too tired to cook. Enough sifatdan keyin keladi: he isn't old enough to drive.

scenes.title: Dialog: reja
board: Anna: What are you doing this weekend?
Ben: I'm planning to visit my grandparents.
Anna: Do you enjoy driving there?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash dialogi. Ikki do‘st, Anna va Ben, dam olish kunlari haqida gaplashadi. Ben buvi-bobosinikiga borishni rejalashtirgan. Tinglang: u bu yerga qanday boradi, nima uchun va Anna unga nimani taklif qiladi? Dialogda infinitiv va gerund qoliplarini ushlashga urining.
scenes.say: Listen. Anna: What are you doing this weekend? Ben: I'm planning to visit my grandparents. Anna: Do you enjoy driving there? Ben: Not really. It takes three hours, so I'm thinking of taking the train. Anna: Good idea. Remember to book a ticket early! Ben: Thanks, I will.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang. Anna: Dam olish kunlari nima qilasan? Ben: Buvi-bobomnikiga borishni rejalashtiryapman. Anna: U yerga mashinada borishni yoqtirasanmi? Ben: Unchalik emas. Uch soat yo‘l, shuning uchun poyezdda borishni o‘ylayapman. Anna: Yaxshi fikr. Chiptani erta olishni unutma! Ben: Rahmat, olaman.

scenes.title: Dialogni tushunish
board: 1) What is Ben planning to do?
2) Why isn't he keen on driving?
3) What should he remember to do?
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: Ben nima qilishni rejalashtiryapti? Ikkinchi: u nima uchun mashina haydashni yoqtirmaydi? Uchinchi: Anna uni nimani esda tutishga undaydi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan, to‘g‘ri qolip bilan ayting. Dialogni yana bir marta ichingizda eslab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Answer in full sentences. One: What is Ben planning to do? Two: Why isn't he keen on driving? Three: What should he remember to do?
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Bir: Ben nimani rejalashtiryapti? Ikki: Nega haydashni yoqtirmaydi? Uch: Nimani esda tutishi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) He's planning to visit his grandparents.
2) It takes three hours.
3) He should remember to book a ticket early.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “He’s planning to visit his grandparents”, “plan” infinitiv bilan keladi. Ikkinchi: yo‘l uch soat davom etadi, “It takes three hours”. Uchinchi: “He should remember to book a ticket early”, bu kelajakdagi vazifa, shuning uchun “remember to”. Dialogda “thinking of taking”, ya’ni predlogdan keyin gerund ham bor edi, payqadingizmi?
scenes.say: One: He's planning to visit his grandparents. Two: It takes three hours. Three: He should remember to book a ticket early.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: He's planning to visit his grandparents. Ikki: It takes three hours. Uch: He should remember to book a ticket early.

scenes.title: Dialog: ofisda
board: Maria: Could you help me fix the printer?
Tom: Sure. I'm used to dealing with it.
Maria: Did you try turning it off?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog ofisda bo‘ladi. Mariya printer buzilgani uchun Tomdan yordam so‘raydi. Tinglang: Tom nimani sinab ko‘rishni maslahat beradi va natija qanday? Diqqat bilan eshiting, qaysi fe’llardan keyin “to”, qaysilaridan keyin “-ing” kelayotganini.
scenes.say: Listen. Maria: Could you help me fix the printer? Tom: Sure. I'm used to dealing with it. Maria: I tried restarting it, but it won't print. Tom: Did you try changing the paper? Maria: Oh, no. I forgot to put paper in! Tom: No problem. It happens to everyone.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang. Mariya: Printerni tuzatishga yordam bera olasizmi? Tom: Albatta. Men u bilan ishlashga o‘rganib qolganman. Mariya: Qayta yoqib ko‘rdim, lekin chop etmayapti. Tom: Qog‘ozni almashtirib ko‘rdingmi? Mariya: Voy, yo‘q. Qog‘oz solishni unutibman! Tom: Hechqisi yo‘q. Bu hammada bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Tushunish va qolip
board: 1) What did Maria try first?
2) What did she forget to do?
3) Which verb pattern is used after used to?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Mariya birinchi nimani sinab ko‘rdi? Ikkinchi: u nimani qilishni unutdi? Uchinchi: “used to dealing” dagi “to” predlogmi yoki infinitiv belgisi, va undan keyin qanday shakl keladi? To‘liq javob bering. Oxirgi savol grammatik, shuning uchun qoidani eslang.
scenes.say: Answer. One: What did Maria try first? Two: What did she forget to do? Three: In I'm used to dealing, what form follows to?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering. Bir: Mariya avval nimani sinadi? Ikki: U nimani qilishni unutdi? Uch: I'm used to dealing da to dan keyin qanday shakl keladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) She tried restarting it.
2) She forgot to put paper in.
3) -ing form (to is a preposition).
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “She tried restarting it”, ya’ni sinab ko‘rdi, shuning uchun gerund. Ikkinchi: “She forgot to put paper in”, qog‘oz solishni unutdi. Uchinchi: “be used to” dagi “to” predlog, shuning uchun “-ing” keladi: “used to dealing”. Esda tuting: “I used to play” — oldin o‘ynardim, bunda “to” infinitiv belgisi, ma’no butunlay boshqa.
scenes.say: One: She tried restarting it. Two: She forgot to put paper in. Three: The ing form, because in be used to, the word to is a preposition.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: She tried restarting it. Ikki: She forgot to put paper in. Uch: -ing shakli, chunki be used to da to predlog.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz to
board: to → /tə/ (kuchsiz)
want to → /ˈwɒntə/ (wanna)
going to → /ˈɡʌnə/ (gonna)

examples.t: I want to go.
I'm going to call.

scenes.say_native: Talaffuz haqida. Gapda “to” kuchsiz aytiladi: “tu” emas, qisqa “tə”, ya’ni “schwa” bilan. “I want to go” tez aytilganda “wonta go” kabi eshitiladi. Amerika ingliz tilida bu “wanna” deb ham yoziladi, “going to” esa “gonna”. Bu so‘zlashuv shakllari, rasmiy yozuvda ularni ishlatmang. Faqat tinglaganda tanib olish uchun biling. Kuchsiz “to” sizning nutqingizni tabiiy qiladi.
scenes.say: In natural speech, to is weak: it sounds like tə, not too. I want to go sounds like I wonta go. In informal speech, you'll hear wanna and gonna. Don't write them in formal English, but do recognise them.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiiy nutqda to kuchsiz: tə, tu emas. I want to go — I wonta go kabi eshitiladi. Norasmiy nutqda wanna va gonna eshitiladi. Rasmiy yozuvda ularni ishlatmang, lekin tanib oling.

scenes.title: Bir ketishda ikki qolip
board: decide to + verb + enjoy + -ing
want + kim + to + do
too + adj + to + do

examples.t: I decided to stop eating late.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zan bir gapda bir necha qolip uchraydi. “I decided to stop eating late”: “decide” infinitiv oladi, “stop” esa gerund bilan ma’no beradi. Tushunish uchun gapni bo‘laklarga ajrating: har bir fe’l va undan keyingi shakl alohida juft. Shunday qilsangiz, uzun gap ham qiyin ko‘rinmaydi. Ingliz tilida bunday zanjir tabiiy: “She hopes to start learning to drive”.
scenes.say: Sometimes patterns come in a chain. I decided to stop eating late. Decide takes the infinitive, and stop takes the ing form here. Break long sentences into pairs of verbs and check each pair.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zan qoliplar zanjir bo‘lib keladi. I decided to stop eating late. Decide infinitiv oladi, stop esa bu yerda -ing oladi. Uzun gapni juftlarga ajrating va har birini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Xatolarni toping
board: 1) I enjoy to swim in the sea.
2) We went there for to see the museum.
3) She suggested to take a taxi.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapda xato bor. Birinchi: “I enjoy to swim in the sea”. Ikkinchi: “We went there for to see the museum”. Uchinchi: “She suggested to take a taxi”. Har bir xatoni toping, sababini ayting va to‘g‘ri variantni baland ovozda ayting. Fe’lning qaysi guruhga kirishini eslang.
scenes.say: Find and correct the mistakes. One: I enjoy to swim in the sea. Two: We went there for to see the museum. Three: She suggested to take a taxi.
scenes.say_uz: Xatolarni toping va tuzating. Bir: I enjoy to swim in the sea. Ikki: We went there for to see the museum. Uch: She suggested to take a taxi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I enjoy swimming in the sea.
2) We went there to see the museum.
3) She suggested taking a taxi.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I enjoy swimming”, chunki “enjoy” gerund bilan keladi. Ikkinchi: “We went there to see the museum”, maqsadda “for to” bo‘lmaydi. Uchinchi: “She suggested taking a taxi”, chunki “suggest” gerund oladi. Uchalasini to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, bugungi eng keng tarqalgan xatolardan qutuldingiz.
scenes.say: One: I enjoy swimming in the sea. Two: We went there to see the museum. Three: She suggested taking a taxi.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: I enjoy swimming in the sea. Ikki: We went there to see the museum. Uch: She suggested taking a taxi.

scenes.title: Qoliplarni yodlash usuli
board: Kartochka: fe’l + qolip + misol
Ro‘yxat: want to · enjoy -ing
Lug‘atda har yangi fe’lni qolibi bilan yozing
scenes.say_native: Qoliplarni qanday yodlaymiz? Birinchi, yangi fe’lni lug‘atga alohida emas, qolibi bilan yozing: “enjoy plus -ing”, “decide plus to”. Ikkinchi, har bir fe’lga o‘zingizga tegishli bitta gap tuzing: “I enjoy cooking”. Uchinchi, guruhlarga ajrating: bir ustunda infinitiv, boshqasida gerund. Yaxshi lug‘atlar, masalan Oxford yoki Cambridge, fe’l qolibini ko‘rsatadi, shuni tekshirib turing.
scenes.say: Learn verbs together with their patterns. Write enjoy plus ing, decide plus to. Make one personal sentence for each verb. Put verbs in two columns, to and ing. Good dictionaries show the pattern after each verb.
scenes.say_uz: Fe’llarni qolipi bilan birga yodlang. Enjoy plus ing, decide plus to deb yozing. Har bir fe’l uchun o‘zingizga tegishli gap tuzing. Fe’llarni ikki ustunga ajrating. Yaxshi lug‘atlar qolipni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Sizning gaplaringiz
board: I want to ... · I enjoy ...
I'm learning English to ...
I'm looking forward to ...
scenes.say_native: Endi sizning navbatingiz. O‘zingiz haqingizda to‘rtta gap ayting: bittasi “I want to”, bittasi “I enjoy”, bittasi maqsad, ya’ni “I’m learning English to”, va bittasi “I’m looking forward to” bilan. Bu mashq sizning shaxsiy javobingiz, shuning uchun noto‘g‘ri javob yo‘q. Faqat qolipni to‘g‘ri tanlang. To‘xtang va baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Your turn. Say four sentences about yourself: one with want to, one with enjoy, one expressing purpose, and one with looking forward to.
scenes.say_uz: Navbat sizda. O‘zingiz haqingizda to‘rtta gap ayting: want to bilan, enjoy bilan, maqsadni bildiruvchi va looking forward to bilan.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I want to travel abroad.
I enjoy reading in the evening.
I'm learning English to get a better job.
I'm looking forward to meeting new people.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna javoblar. “I want to travel abroad.” “I enjoy reading in the evening.” “I’m learning English to get a better job.” “I’m looking forward to meeting new people.” Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin. Tekshirish juda oson: “want” dan keyin “to”, “enjoy” dan keyin “-ing”, maqsadda “to”, “looking forward to” dan keyin “-ing”. Hammasi mos kelsa, ajoyib.
scenes.say: Here are some model answers. I want to travel abroad. I enjoy reading in the evening. I'm learning English to get a better job. I'm looking forward to meeting new people.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna javoblar. I want to travel abroad. I enjoy reading in the evening. I'm learning English to get a better job. I'm looking forward to meeting new people.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: to: want, decide, hope, plan, refuse
-ing: enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, mind
remember/stop/try: ma’no o‘zgaradi
maqsad: to / in order to / so as not to / so that
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: “want, decide, hope, plan” kabi fe’llardan keyin infinitiv keladi. Ikkinchi: “enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, mind” kabi fe’llardan keyin “-ing”. Uchinchi: “remember, stop, try” ikkala shakl bilan ma’no o‘zgartiradi. To‘rtinchi: maqsadni “to”, “in order to”, “so as not to” yoki “so that” bilan ifodalaymiz, “for to” deb bo‘lmaydi. Beshinchi: predlogdan keyin faqat “-ing”. Oltinchi: “want you to”, “let me do”.
scenes.say: Let's review. Want, decide, hope and plan take to. Enjoy, finish, avoid and suggest take ing. Remember, stop and try change meaning. For purpose use to, in order to, so as not to or so that. After a preposition, use ing.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa. Want, decide, hope, plan to oladi. Enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest -ing oladi. Remember, stop, try ma’no o‘zgartiradi. Maqsad uchun to, in order to, so as not to yoki so that ishlating. Predlogdan keyin -ing.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: 10 sentences, 10 different patterns
want to · enjoy -ing · stop to · so as not to ...
Check each verb pattern in a dictionary
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘nta gap yozing va ularda o‘nta turli fe’l qolipidan foydalaning. Masalan, “want to”, “enjoy plus -ing”, “remember to”, “stop plus -ing”, maqsad, “want plus kim plus to”, “let”, “afraid of plus -ing”, “too plus sifat plus to” va “look forward to”. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘nta gapning hammasida fe’l shakli to‘g‘ri va qoliplar takrorlanmaydi. Keyingi darsda eng kerakli o‘ttizta barqaror iborani o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to write ten sentences using ten different verb patterns. Check that every verb has the correct form and that no pattern is repeated. See you in the next lesson!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: o‘nta turli fe’l qolipidan foydalanib o‘nta gap yozing. Har bir fe’l shakli to‘g‘ri va qoliplar takrorlanmasligini tekshiring. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Ingliz tilida 10 ta gap yozing va ularda 10 ta turli fe’l qolipidan foydalaning (want to, enjoy -ing, remember to, stop -ing, maqsad, want + kim + to va boshqalar). Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir fe’l shakli to‘g‘ri, qoliplar takrorlanmaydi.

quiz.q: I enjoy ___ to music in the evening.

quiz.why_uz: Suggest dan keyin gerund keladi; o‘zbekcha ta’sirida to qo‘yish xato.

quiz.q: I went to the pharmacy ___ some medicine.
quiz.why_uz: Maqsad infinitiv bilan ifodalanadi; for to bo‘lmaydi.
Look forward to dagi to predlog, shuning uchun -ing.

quiz.q: Which sentence means he ended the habit?
quiz.why_uz: Stop doing — ishni to‘xtatish; stop to do — to‘xtab boshqa ish qilish.

options: I want that you help me.
I want you to help me.
quiz.why_uz: Want + kim + to + fe’l; that bilan tuzib bo‘lmaydi.
Let dan keyin to siz infinitiv keladi.
Inkor maqsad: so as not to + fe’l.
Too + sifat + to — ortiqcha, shuning uchun mumkin emas.
